title: Smart Access & Monitoring System — SAMS
summary: An 8051 access-control and environmental-monitoring design combining PIN authentication, sensor inputs, event logging and emergency override.
overview: SAMS brings access control and environmental monitoring into one 8051 academic design. Its scope includes multi-level PIN authentication, temperature and light sensing, an interrupt-driven emergency override and event logging. The supplied image is a Proteus schematic; it supports the circuit design but does not establish a physical hardware prototype.
approach: Organised multi-level PIN entry through a 4×3 keypad and LCD feedback.
Included LM35 temperature and LDR light sensing in the monitoring design.
Specified interrupt-driven emergency override, hardware timers and FIFO/circular-buffer event logging.
Combined LCD/LED feedback and relay door control in the supplied Proteus schematic.
components: Interrupts, hardware timers and circular-buffer logging
outcomes: The supplied Proteus schematic documents the proposed circuit integration.
The project develops academic practice in authentication logic, sensing, interrupt handling and event logging.
Physical implementation and measured performance remain unverified from the supplied material.
